Bombay High Court rules against externment for political protest

The Bombay High Court has ruled that citizens cannot be externed for participating in political protests, stating they are not "slaves." The court cancelled the externment of political activists, finding that slogans like "BJP murdabad" do not constitute sufficient grounds for such action. This decision affirms the right to protest against government actions.
